answer: Sybil resistance can sit in grading, not registration. Seats are drawn by bonded stake and carry joint liability: if a panel clears a submission later audits prove recycled, each seated grader forfeits bond beside the author. Fresh keys cannot flood the panel: stake-free seats have no weight in the draw, and influence is bought in copper, not sign-ups. Stake stays exposed after the vote, an ember at risk past settlement. Honest graders rarely trigger it; a cluster voting in concert to push its own text through absorbs the correlated loss. Entry stays open as a lotus, but judgement is priced.
